notionRepairBatches.text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/40617d16de4c81ab8747ebc5d0ec71da as of 2026-10-27T17:19:00.146Z: {"title":"Pliny｜France Wine Producer Link Repair & Legal Corrections · 2026-10-28 · Batch 02"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔗"} · Pliny · Global first-edition research only; SOMM100 App publishing HOLD. ## Executive result — France Producer / Wine continuation Existing France-only canonical graph had 607 physical Producer rows (542 distinct Canonical IDs with 65 duplicate pairs), 1,042 Wine rows and 158 Wines without a Producer relation as of the last complete prior SQL recount. Today: - 8 new Producer Draft records created (Tempier, Domaines Ott umbrella, its three separately identified estates, Mas Amiel, Clos Cibonne, Domaine Jules Desjourneys). - 32 existing Wine→Producer relation fixes were written and bidirectionally verified by fetching all eight Producer pages (totals 6 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 9 + 4 + 7 = 32). No duplicate wine records created. - France orphan Wine estimate: 158 - 32 = 126 remaining. This is an arithmetic expectation, not a new table-wide recount. Notion Query Data Source allowance was exhausted before a current SQL census; do not claim 126 SQL verified. - Producer rows expected 615, distinct Producer canonical IDs expected 550 if no parallel writer changed them; actual table totals have not been recounted. - No Producer or Wine approved by Nova in this batch. Verification statuses remain Draft or legacy Seed according to actual source-completeness. - No existing Producer duplicate ID records deleted or automatically merged (65 groups remain to audit). No App release. ## Verified bi-directional links | Producer / entity | Notion source record | Related existing Wines verified | | --- | --- | --- | | Domaine Tempier | | 6 | | Domaines Ott — umbrella | | 1 (Étoile) | | Domaines Ott — Château de Selle | | 1 | | Domaines Ott — Clos Mireille | | 2 | | Domaines Ott — Château Romassan | | 2 | | Mas Amiel | | 9 | | Clos Cibonne | | 4 | | Domaine Jules Desjourneys | | 7 | ## Producer/Wine technical deepening actually written ### Domaine Tempier (6 Wine pages) - All six existing Bandol wines now linked to producer, grape relationships, parcel and terroir descriptions, approximate producer house blend formulas, manual/native yeast cellar protocol and foudre ageing as supported by primary estate sources. Content expanded in existing wine pages with verification Draft. - Tourtine: 5.5 ha south-facing wind-exposed Santonian sandstone/marl; estate blend \~85% Mourvèdre, balance Grenache/Cinsault; foudre 18 months minimum. - La Migoua: c.11 ha complex geology, \~55% Mourvèdre plus Cinsault/Grenache/Syrah house recipe. - Cabassaou: c.1.5 ha warmer sheltered amphitheatre; \~92–94% Mourvèdre plus small Syrah/Cinsault; oldest vine source 60+ years; foudre ≥18 months. - Blanc: Clairette 60% / Ugni Blanc 30% / Rolle, Bourboulenc, Marsanne remainder; no Bourboulenc grape canonical node currently verified. - Rosé: \~50% Mourvèdre, Grenache/Cinsault and direct-press/maceration in stainless/concrete. - Existing generic Bandol Rouge may correspond to currently marketed Cuvée Lulu & Lucien; legacy vs modern label identity still unresolved, do not silently rename or multiply. - Estate source: [Terroirs](https://www.domainetempier.com/les-terroirs/), [Cuvée list](https://www.domainetempier.com/les-vins/), and the 6 specific cuvée pages linked in wine Vintage Notes. ### Domaines Ott (6 links + key AOC correction) - Kept one branded umbrella Producer and separate physical estates for Château de Selle (Côtes de Provence), Clos Mireille (Côtes de Provence), Château Romassan (Bandol). The Étoile cross-estate blended wine links to umbrella only. - Corrected Étoile : official category Vin de France rosé, NOT Côtes de Provence AOC. Removed incorrect AOC Appellation relation, linked Grenache Noir + Mourvèdre and included official 2024 technical sheet 80%/20%, with 20% maturation in ceramic spheres. Existing canonical ID embeds wrong AOC string; ID migration is an explicit QA queue item, not changed in place to avoid broken dependencies. - Updated 5 other Ott wines with provenance to the correct physical estate, AOC, soil/site context. No invented vintage blend percentages. - Sources: [Three estates](https://www.domaines-ott.com/en/our-three-estates), [Current wines](https://www.domaines-ott.com/en/our-wines), [Étoile](https://www.domaines-ott.com/etoile), [2024 technical fiche](https://www.domaines-ott.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/domaines-ott-fiche-technique-vin-de-france-etoile-2024-fr.pdf). ### Mas Amiel (9 links + VDN technical sources) - All nine legacy Maury Wine identities now link to Mas Amiel Draft producer. - Source-backed separate Vintage (fresh fruit/mutage sur grains/reductive) vs Oxidative wine ageing (outdoor glass bonbonnes \~1y then large old oak foudres over decades); this cannot be flattened into a single vinification style. - Vintage Blanc 2025 linked to Grenache Gris, AOC Maury Blanc, source documented 100% Grenache Gris, schist/older goblet vineyard, mid-fermentation juice mutage and 10 months reductive lees/tank. - 50 Ans d'Âge confirmed official aged Maury product via Trésors du Temps set; 100% Grenache Noir per dedicated product entry. Missing in one standard catalogue is not evidence the wine never existed. - 20/30/40-year ages are multi-vintage oxidative selections and not the same thing as a harvest vintage. Specific technical details still pending. - Historic Maury Millésime record needs an actual vintage/label reference before more precise claims. - Sources: [VDN process](https://www.masamiel.fr/pages/vinification-vins-doux), [Official vintage white 2025](https://www.masamiel.fr/products/vintage-blanc-2025), [Trésors du Temps](https://www.masamiel.fr/products/tresors-du-temps). ### Clos Cibonne (4 links, two critical Seed/identity holds) - Founded Producer Draft and linked 4 original wines. - Cuvée Caroline Rosé and Cuvée des Vignettes source-checked on official 2024 estate catalog for Tibouren/Grenache, foudre vs 300 L barrique treatment and old-vine origins; both moved to Draft. - Cuvée Olivier Rosé legacy name conflicts with estate's Cuvée Prestige Olivier Rouge 2023; preserved old wine title/Seed and flagged color/identity QA, did NOT convert to red without historical label proof. - Cuvée Spéciale Tibouren: legacy wine identity ambiguous, current estate markets a 2025 rouge; retain Seed until wine colour/vintage provenance reconciled. - Sources: [Producer family](https://www.clos-cibonne.com/fr/historique-clos-cibonne-complet.html), [Current official offer](https://www.clos-cibonne.com/fr/bon-de-commande.php), [Portfolio](https://www.clos-cibonne.com/fr/gamme-crus-classes-provence.html). ### Domaine Jules Desjourneys (7 links, historical naming clues) - Created multi-region Producer record (Beaujolais + Burgundy) linked to Moulin-à-Vent, Fleurie, Chénas and Pouilly-Fuissé where supported. - Expanded existing 7 wine records with official geography, terroirs, Gamay where appropriate, separate wine/site descriptions and current vs older names. - Les Michelons currently shown on official estate site as Aux Michelons; flagged alias rather than duplicate. - Les Ménétrières official Puits de Lumière product explicitly says ex-Ménétrières. Preserved historical canonical wine ID as Seed; do not add separate Puits de Lumière until vintage/continuity QA. - Producer official timeline: inaugural vintage 2007; Chénas Jugement Dernier introduced in 2012. The estate's symbolic poetic Jules 'origin story' does not establish that a real person Jules founded the company; legal notice names SARL Jules Desjourneys and Fabien Duperray as publication manager. - Sources: [Wine catalogue](https://www.julesdesjourneys.fr/categorie-produit/les-blancs/), [Historic timeline](https://www.julesdesjourneys.fr/desjourney-dans-le-temps/), [Puits de Lumière / ex-Ménétrières](https://www.julesdesjourneys.fr/produit/pouilly-fuisse-puits-de-lumiere/). ## Pending QA / next work without App release 1. Fix estimated 126 remaining orphan Wine→Producer relations, prioritizing complete grouped work rather than wine-title guesswork: Domaine Comte Abbatucci (11), Domaine Gauby (6), Domaine Jean Foillard (4), and other Producer missing groups. 2. Reconcile 65 Producer duplicate Canonical ID pairs, retaining original page IDs and linked records. One Maxime Magnon pair has existing Wine links on one side; merge there is higher risk. 3. For all source-enriched Drafts, Nova independently verify actual vintage specs, ownership, vineyard vs purchased fruit, colour/classification/legal facts and naming aliases before Reviewed. 4. Fill critical global grape nodes including Bourboulenc with sourced viticultural/identity standards; inspect country legal AOC records individually, avoid wrong AOC labels for Vin de France blends. 5. Keep research isolated from SOMM100 App. No interim deploy, no 'App completed' claims.

notionRepairBatches.text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/40617d16de4c81c7bb39dd6a8d2ea9d8 as of 2026-10-27T17:53:14.522Z: {"title":"Pliny｜France Wine Library Canonical Repair · Batch 03 · 2026-10-28"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔍"} · Owner: Pliny · Wine Library research only · SOMM100 App publication HOLD ## Batch 03 — actual database repair This report documents completed Notion changes, not a claim of global completion. Seven new France Producer Drafts created, 32 previously orphaned individual Wine records linked to the appropriate Producers, and one source-backed Côtes Catalanes IGP legal entity created. Bidirectional reverse relations were fetched for all seven Producers and the IGP; links matched the intended sets. No duplicate Wine rows were created or deleted and no App deployment occurred. | Producer (new canonical Draft) | Wine links repaired | Source scope | | --- | --- | --- | | Domaine Comte Abbatucci | 11 | Corsica native grape conservatory, Parcellaires, Collection | | Domaine Gauby | 6 | Calce Roussillon, old-vine sites, IGP-vs-AOC vintage | | Domaine Jean Foillard | 4 | Morgon Côte du Py, Corcelette, Charmes, 3.14 | | Château Simone | 3 | Palette Blanc, Rouge, Rosé, limestone terroir | | Domaine du Clos des Fées | 5 | Roussillon microparcels, 2020/2024 wine sheets, aliases | | Domaine Marcel Lapierre | 2 | Morgon, Camille, source-name M & C Lapierre | | Domaine Jean-Marc Burgaud | 1 | Morgon Côte du Py, established 1989 | Total verified repaired Wine relations this batch: 32. Starting orphan count was only estimated 126 after Batch 02; expected \~94 remain if no parallel modifications. Query Data Source access currently unavailable, so the number 94 is NOT a verified table-wide SQL count. Previous duplicate Producer ID groups remain 65 awaiting source-preserving resolution. Reviewed/Approved status was not awarded; research only. ## Critical technical and provenance corrections ### Domaine Comte Abbatucci - Official producer history documents Jean-Charles / Faustine Abbatucci, roughly 21ha Corsican Taravo granitic vineyards and native varieties [Estate](https://www.domaine-abbatucci.com/). - Among Parcellaires, Alte Rosso is a WHITE Barbarossa; Monte Bianco is a RED Sciaccarellu; Valle di Nero is a ROSÉ from Carcajolo Nero. Do not infer colour from Italian-sounding names. [Parcellaires](https://www.domaine-abbatucci.com/fr/vins-de-terroir/parcellaires). - Faustine Rouge house 70% Sciaccarellu/30% Niellucciu; Blanc Vermentino; Rosé Sciaccarellu. Global Grape Sangiovese already holds Niellucciu as alias; do not create a duplicate Niellucciu species. [Faustine wines](https://www.domaine-abbatucci.com/fr/vins-de-terroir/faustine). - Current winery fiche says Ministre Impérial is RED Vin de France, while the older same-name imported record uses Ajaccio AOC. Both old Wine pages linked but original Ajaccio row remains Seed and flagged for historical wine-label review, NOT auto merged. [Collections](https://www.domaine-abbatucci.com/fr/vins-de-terroir/collections), [technical source](https://www.domaine-abbatucci.com/uploads/d41dd729a570ba6e27b592ddd33ab2fd.pdf). - Multiple indigenous grapes lack matching canonical Grape IDs; literal names preserved, not linked to guesses. ### Domaine Gauby and 2026 legal geography - New Côtes Catalanes IGP has legal-source Draft profile and 4 Wine reverse links. IGP is distinct from Côtes du Roussillon Villages AOC. Original [2020 IGP order](https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000041885073/) and [October 2026 exceptional rules](https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/article_lc/LEGIARTI000054995973) retained with effective-date cautions. - La Muntada 2023 currently documented IGP Côtes Catalanes 70% Grenache/30% Carignan, old AOC/other blends belong to different vintages and cannot be generalized. [2023 tech distributor](https://www.vigneronsdexception.com/fr/domaine-gauby/8912-domaine-gauby-muntada-rouge-2023.html). - Coume Gineste and Vieilles Vignes Blanc/Rouge received canonical grape links and IGP source references where supported; Carignan Blanc still missing a separately verified grape master. - Old source “Les Calcinaires” is colour-ambiguous, as RED and WHITE exist; “La Roque” modern classification unknown. Keep Seed, do not assign blind blends. [Regional distributor](https://www.legardevins.com/nos-domaines/domaine-gauby/). ### Domaine Jean Foillard and Beaujolais estates - Foillard Côte du Py, Corcelette, Les Charmes/Eponym' and Cuvée 3.14 all linked to Gamay; individual Morgon terroirs and winemaking documented as source-era with ageing/vine age caveats. [Importer/producer record](https://kermitlynch.com/grower/jean-foillard/). - Domaine Marcel Lapierre now has one canonical Producer entity; historic “M & C Lapierre” Wine names remain searchable legacy aliases, not separate wineries. Official estate records 1909 family beginnings, Marcel leading from 1973, Mathieu family continuity after 2010, Camille joining 2013, Ecocert organic since 2004. Morgon is multi-site; Cuvée Camille a different single Côte/Roche du Py site and release. [Estate](https://www.marcel-lapierre.com/en/the-domaine), [Camille](https://www.marcel-lapierre.com/en/product/cuvee-camille), [Cellar](https://www.marcel-lapierre.com/en/viticulture-and-vinification/). - Jean-Marc Burgaud founded estate 1989, now describes 17.5ha split 12.5ha Morgon /5ha Lantignié. Côte du Py Gamay terroir on iron-rich blue schist; source years differ in maceration days. [Estate](https://jean-marc-burgaud.com/le-domaine), [Côte du Py](https://jean-marc-burgaud.com/nos-vins). ### Château Simone / Palette - All three historic Wine records matched to Château Simone and source-researched separately. Palette Blanc house formula includes Clairette, Grenache Blanc, Bourboulenc, Ugni Blanc, Muscat Blanc; red and deeply coloured gastronomic Rosé have separately documented house profiles. Ratios are not all-vintage laws. Exact Bourboulenc/Muscat grape links pending, rather than inventing them. [Blanc](https://chateau-simone.fr/en/chateau-simone-white), [Rouge](https://chateau-simone.fr/en/chateau-simone-red), [Rosé](https://chateau-simone.fr/en/chateau-simone-rose). - Rougier family history has discrepant 1946/47 château-specific historic wine-AOC milestone; independent original legal proof needed. Palette recognized 1948. ### Domaine du Clos des Fées - All five old wine rows linked. Source-backed Le Clos des Fées Rouge 2020: Grenache25%/Mourvèdre10%/Syrah50%/Carignan15%, \~18 months new-oak cellar for that dated sheet. - La Petite Sibérie 2024: Grenache96%, Mourvèdre2%, Syrah2%; wind-exposed iron-schist old vine site; winery described 2023 original crop under differently named Post Scriptum rather than regular La Petite Sibérie. - De battre mon cœur s'est arrêté 2024: Syrah97%, Grenache3%, approx 2.7ha S/SE-facing granitic Lesquerde, steel élevage. Wine's legal IGP-vs-AOC label remains unconfirmed; Appellation field intentionally not guessed. - Ambiguous old “Vieilles Vignes” and “Les Sorcières” Seeds each refer to potentially separate BLANC vs ROUGE wines. Kept old canonical records and marked exact colour/vintage unresolved. [Winery original current & vintage sheets](https://www.lapetiteepicerieduclosdesfees.com/), [vintage archive](https://www.lapetiteepicerieduclosdesfees.com/3-anciens-millesimes). ## Next quality gates and blockers 1. Continue source-led grouping of estimated \~94 remaining orphan Wine entries; highest-value upcoming: Domaine Ganevat, Mas Jullien, Domaine Peyre Rose, Clos Venturi, and other country MS legacy sets. 2. Resolve 65 Producer duplicate canonical ID pairs conservatively without deleting original citations or incoming Wine/Appellation relations. 3. Audit changing AOC/IGP classifications, heritage grape IDs and renamed cuvées; wine vintage exceptions are not timeless estate rules. 4. Nova editorial QA before Reviewed/Approved; country-wide research completeness and legal primary sources required before coordinated App handoff. No interim SOMM100 App release.

properties.History EN: Bandol property with roots before the modern revival. Lucie 'Lulu' Tempier and Lucien Peyraud took over in 1940; the estate began replanting Mourvèdre, Cinsault and Grenache from 1943. Jean-Marie and François Peyraud developed parcel-specific red cuvées in the 1960s. Winery foudre cellar built in 1968.

properties.Vineyards & Sites: Estate official site describes a c.60 ha terroir mosaic: La Bastide (c.7 ha, source for classical blends), La Tourtine (c.5.5 ha, sunny/south and windy Santonian sandstone/marl/clay), La Migoua (c.11 ha, complex overthrust Triassic clay-limestone in Beausset-Vieux), Cabassaou (c.1.5 ha, warm sheltered amphitheater), La Laidière (c.18 ha, east-facing, purchased 2016, contributes to freshness in white/rose). Do not infer all land is individually owned without cadastral source.

notionProducers.title: Domaine Comte Abbatucci

properties.History EN: Family wine estate in Taravo valley, Casalabriva, southern Corsica. Antoine Abbatucci established an ampelographic collection of traditional Corsican grapes; Jean-Charles developed the estate's biodynamic and heritage varietal research. The Collection range celebrating historical family figures began from 2006. Estate website names Jean-Charles and his daughter Faustine Abbatucci as owner-vignerons (2026 source snapshot).
properties.Name: Domaine Comte Abbatucci
properties.People & Ownership: Jean-Charles Abbatucci and daughter Faustine Abbatucci described by official estate website as proprietors. Historical ampelographic conservatory started by Antoine Abbatucci. Legal website publisher: EARL DOMAINE COMTE ABBATUCCI (2026 legal notice); beneficial share breakdown not stated.
properties.Portfolio Notes: At least 10 distinct wine identities among 11 existing source records: Faustine Blanc, Rouge, Rosé (+ separate historical Faustine Vieilles Vignes Rosé), Parcellaires Alte Rosso Blanc, Monte Bianco Rouge, Valle di Nero Rosé, Collection Ministre Impérial Rouge, Diplomate d'Empire Blanc, Général de la Révolution Blanc. Existing 2 'Ministre Impérial' records use different origination labels, one Ajaccio AOC and another Vin de France; official current technical sheet says Vin de France — hold the Ajaccio record for source/label reconciliation; no automatic merge. Official additional Empire Sparkling, Dolce Rosso and Insolites Valle di Mare/Monte Mare not yet among 11, audit for expansion later.
properties.Vineyards & Sites: Estate's own official account describes 21 hectares of vineyards on decomposed granitic sands near 150m altitude in Taravo valley, Casalabriva, with an ampelographic collection preserving diverse native varieties. Biodynamic viticulture; precise parcel-by-cuvée origin and official land-title verification pending.
properties.Vinification: Portfolio approaches vary: Faustine whites/rosés mostly stainless; red structured maceration, Collection whites demi-muid & inox; Parcellaires may use foudre, demi-muid, tank. No blanket all-vintages rule.
properties.Viticulture: Biodynamic production and native Corsican varietal conservation per official estate. The term '18 old/native varieties' on site is a conservation count, not a universal ingredient count for each cuvée.

notionProducers.content:
## Producer history / current identity

Family estate in Villié-Morgon since Michel Lapierre arrived in 1909; his son Camille developed bottling; Marcel took over 1973, pioneered no-added-sulfur winemaking under Jules Chauvet's influence from 1981. Marcel passed in October 2010. Mathieu joined 2004 and took management in 2010; sister Camille joined 2013, with Anne later involved. Original SOMM100 wine imports styled producer as 'Domaine M & C Lapierre', a branding/management naming variant, not a second estate.

## Ownership and people

Lapierre family: Marcel (historic winemaker; died 2010), Mathieu (management and vinification from 2010), Camille (joined 2013), Anne (current estate people page), Marie (historic estate viticulture/sales). Current beneficial ownership shares not independently documented.

## Vineyards and terroir

2026 official winery reports about 20 hectares Gamay noir à jus blanc, predominantly Morgon, a few sites Beaujolais; Cuvée Camille on Côte/Roche du Py SW facing 1ha shallow granitic bedrock site in official source. Certified organic since 2004 per estate; organic farming practices started historically around 1981.

## Vinification / technical approach

Hand harvest and sorting, semi-carbonic Beaujolais maceration with indigenous yeast; limited or no sulfur through vinification but bottling practices vary by wine/year. Cuvée Camille has longer 2025-type semi-carbonic fermentation in wooden tronconic vat; exact times/year not generalized.

## Portfolio and identity source

Legacy Wine master has two unlinked rows named 'Domaine M & C Lapierre — Morgon' and 'Domaine M & C Lapierre — Cuvée Camille Roche du Py'. Both link to this ONE estate canonical identity. Official portfolio broader, including Cuvée Marcel Lapierre, Raisins Gaulois, Beaujolais, Bourgogne Pinot Noir; no duplicate creation without source inventory.

corrections.finding: Later Notion properties classify Étoile as Vin de France rosé. The legacy ID and body embed Côtes de Provence. Keep ID as a legacy alias if migrating; do not derive origin from the slug.
corrections.replacement_scope: 2024 only: 80% Grenache / 20% Mourvèdre; 20% raised in ceramic spheres; 14% ABV; serving 10–12°C. These figures are not all-vintage rules.

corrections.finding: Umbrella and three physical estates are distinct producer identities; Étoile belongs to umbrella. Château de Selle and Clos Mireille relate to Côtes de Provence, Château Romassan to Bandol. Group relationship is not a single contiguous vineyard.
Producer portfolio paragraph is stale: later repair report and enriched wine properties confirm 50 Ans d'Âge via official Trésors du Temps product. Age designation is not a harvest vintage.
2025 producer-source draft: 100% Grenache Gris, ten months reductive tank ageing on lees. Attach only to 2025.

Legacy Cuvée Olivier Rosé conflicts with current Prestige Olivier Rouge 2023; Cuvée Spéciale Tibouren legacy identity has unqualified colour while current 2025 product is red. Do not silently rename/recolour or manufacture separate releases.

Current Aux Michelons versus legacy Les Michelons is a naming alias to review. Current Puits de Lumière explicitly references ex-Ménétrières; preserve historical relationship without adding a second wine or claiming continuity for every vintage.
Alte Rosso is white (Barbarossa), Monte Bianco is red (Sciaccarellu), Valle di Nero is rosé (Carcajolo Nero). Do not infer colour from the label language.

Current source describes Ministre Impérial Vin de France Rouge. Legacy Ajaccio row lacks a dated label establishing separate historical release. Preserve legacy identity as held; do not count both as two verified wines.
Later dated sources use IGP Côtes Catalanes. La Muntada 2023 is 70% Grenache / 30% Carignan. Do not carry historical AOC/other-vintage blend into 2023. IGP legal dossier has not been imported to app.
La Roque current identity/classification unresolved. Les Calcinaires colour ambiguous; current distributor lists separate white and red. No automatic merge or current vintage invention.

Le Clos des Fées 2020: Grenache25/Mourvèdre10/Syrah50/Carignan15 and about18months newoak. Petite Sibérie2024: Grenache96/Mourvèdre2/Syrah2; 2023 was Post Scriptum naming. De battre mon cœur s'est arrêté2024: Syrah97/Grenache3; exact legal origin remains held. Treat each dated recipe separately.
Unqualified legacy names do not establish colour; producer sells distinct red/white products.

M & C Lapierre is a legacy producer naming variant for current Marcel Lapierre estate record in repair cohort; do not create extra producer merely from wine slug. Current canonical producer is producer-fr-domaine-marcel-lapierre.
Current importer name Les Charmes Eponym' and historic Eponym' should be aliases, not independent wines, subject to label/vintage confirmation.

Gauby website is distributor Le Garde Vins; Foillard website is importer Kermit Lynch. Preserve source type, never label either winery official website. Producer tasting prose is house style, not independent critical tasting or score.

All 64 fetched wine pages retain original placeholder body sections while later enrichment lives in properties. For Oct28 correction import use enriched properties plus repair report; do not overwrite with old body. This research snapshot preserves both for audit.

Les Saint-Jacques is village Rully, not PremierCru. Cuvée Ronde PremierCru entry is confirmed2021only after frost; do not imply annual separate releases of component premiers crus or confuse with another Bourgogne Cuvée Ronde.

sourceIssuesFromFR004.finding: No live SOMM100 application schema, database exports, or API mapping were inspected; output is CONTENT DRAFT PENDING MAPPING.
INAO database catalog checked, but the raw nationwide AOC registry could not be materialized; non-Burgundy/non-Alsace items are candidate identities, not legally audited complete AOP dossiers.

BIVB confirms 84 Bourgogne AOCs: 7 Regional, 44 Village, 33 Grand Cru; DGC and Premier Cru are NOT extra independent AOCs. The 13-versus-14 additional geographical denomination presentation requires current regulation reconciliation.
2026-06-11 cahier des charges: Sainte-Foy/Francs/Blaye/Cadillac/Castillon are DGC of Côtes de Bordeaux, not each a newly distinct AOC. Historical Sainte-Foy-Bordeaux not current AOC.
Domaine de Villaine Rully Les Saint-Jacques is village Rully (the domaine parcel sits below premier cru Clos Saint-Jacques); do not mark as 1er Cru.
Domaine de Villaine 2021 Cuvée Ronde combines grapes from six premier crus following spring frost; do not fabricate normal release of all six separate cuvées.
51 named Alsace GC AOCs; do not apply blanket Riesling/Gewurztraminer/Pinot Gris/Muscat rule across every climat or vintage. Sylvaner and Pinot Noir exceptions are legal-rule/version dependent.
Champagne grand cru/premier cru village categories are NOT separate Champagne AOPs nor Burgundy-style climat grand crus.
Bordeaux 1855, Saint-Émilion classification, Graves classification, Champagne cru classification, Provençal Cru Classé distinguish estate classifications from AOP hierarchy.
Dry whites produced by sweet wine estates may be sold as generic Bordeaux AOP rather than Barsac/Sauternes; Château Climens Asphodèle and Y d’Yquem need per-cuvée legal labeling.
Domaine Jacqueson / Domaine Paul & Marie Jacqueson / P. et M. Jacqueson same estate, but Domaine Ponsot, Jean-Baptiste Ponsot, Sylvain & Lucie Ponsot are NOT necessarily one producer.
Historical dollar/RMB wine prices from user notes are deliberately excluded from all current prices.
Ownership and founder details in older notes are time-bound; must be confirmed by producer/company registry before stating as of 2026.
Vin de France and IGP Alpilles are not AOP; Pineau des Charentes is a mistelle category and requires appropriate rules.
An index is not a verified GIS vineyard boundary or cadastrally checked parcel; maps require official polygon/cadastral IDs.
Many cult Roussillon/Languedoc/Corsica cuvées have non-AOP labels. Kept unverified label as null AOP instead of force assigning to nearby AOP.

The pre-2021 Domaine Belluard Ayze and Gringet roster is HISTORICAL. Successor producer/release lineage and actual current legal company must be separately researched before treating as currently marketed estate wine.
AOC Moselle of Lorraine is a French region and independent of the German Mosel; cross-language search synonyms are not legal equivalence.
Maison Lelièvre winery reports c.20 ha vinified on own estate page while 2026 marketing collateral mentions c.50ha. Record scope/ownership discrepancy and confirm directly.
Domaine Sontag 2026 Prix d’Excellence concerns the estate; it must not be converted into a 2024 wine point score.

record.name: Domaine de Villaine
Domaine Dureuil-Janthial
record.name_zh: Domaine Dureuil-Janthial

location.address: 10 rue de la Buisserolle, 71150 Rully, France

history.zh: Janthial 家族的 Rully 渊源可追溯至十三世纪。Céline 与 Vincent Dureuil 于 1994 年承接家族酒庄；Vincent 获得 La Revue du Vin de France 2019 年度 Vigneron。旧文将其定位为 Rully 风土复兴代表；这属于报道评价，不是官方法定等级。
history.en: The Janthial family has roots in Rully dating to the 13th century. Céline and Vincent Dureuil took over in 1994. Vincent was named 2019 Vigneron of the Year by La Revue du Vin de France.

ownership.notes_zh: 家族经营；未找到应被写入的集团收购或持股比例，不编造。
ownership.notes_en: Family-operated; no unverified corporate stakes are asserted.

vineyards.zh: 官网记载约 20 ha，涵盖 Rully、Mercurey、Puligny-Montrachet 与 Nuits-Saint-Georges；其中某些微小地块仅 0.0871 ha。不同地块的老藤栽植年份均按酒款技术单保留。
vineyards.en: Official estate description cites approximately 20 ha across Rully, Mercurey, Puligny-Montrachet and Nuits-Saint-Georges. Parcels and planting years are preserved at the wine level.

viticulture.zh: 强调土壤生命力、有机导向、人工采收、产量管理和地块区分。公开技术单提到不同地块及手工分选；有机证书状态需另外确认，不能单凭报道宣称最新认证。
viticulture.en: Focus on living soils, organic-oriented farming, hand picking, crop load and parcel precision. Current certification status requires independent verification.

vinification.zh: 2019 版白葡萄酒技术单：直接压榨、约 48 小时静置澄清、木桶酒精发酵、约 12 个月桶熟和约 6 个月不锈钢熟成；红葡萄酒双重分选、视年份去梗与否、木质截锥形发酵罐、浸渍和桶熟。文件中的新桶比例是历史技术基准而非所有年份恒定数字。
vinification.en: 2019 baseline sheets: direct pressing and 48 h settling for whites, fermentation in barrel, roughly 12 months in wood plus 6 in stainless steel. Reds: double sorting, vintage-dependent destemming, wooden vats/cold soak, about 12 months in oak plus 6 months in tank. Oak percentages are sheet-specific, not universal vintage facts.

record.name: Domaine P. et M. Jacqueson

history.zh: Henri Jacqueson 于 1946 年利用家族土地在 Rully 建庄；Paul 于 1970 年代初参与经营。第三代 Marie（2006）及 Pierre（约 2015）接手管理，推动 Rully 与 Mercurey、Bouzeron 的地块型酒款。
history.en: Founded in 1946 by Henri Jacqueson on ancestral plots in Rully. Paul joined in the early 1970s; Marie joined estate management in 2006 and Pierre later joined around 2015. The estate spans Rully, Mercurey and Bouzeron.

land.zh: 约 18 ha（经分销商及地方旅游资料），以 Rully 为主，也在 Mercurey 和 Bouzeron。地块栽植年代依进口商历史资料，不当作每年份的即时藤龄。
land.en: About 18 ha, concentrated in Rully with parcels in Mercurey and Bouzeron. Historical planting dates are importer-provided, not current vintage vine ages.

viticulture.zh: 采用 culture raisonnée，人工采收、择优去梗与分选。不能自动称作有机认证酒庄。
viticulture.en: Sustainable/reasoned viticulture, hand harvesting, fruit sorting. No unsupported organic-certification claim.

vinification.zh: 经销与进口商资料记述桶熟约 12 个月；桶种、新桶比例依酒款和年份核查，不对全部酒款强加统一比例。
vinification.en: Distributor/importer accounts mention roughly 12 months barrel ageing; actual oak composition varies by label and vintage.

ownership.zh: Jacqueson 家族经营；没有可靠的集团股权事实可写。
ownership.en: Family-owned and operated; no unverified corporate holding stated.

record.name: Domaine Ninot
people: René Ninot — grandfather, historical Rully advocate
Flavien Ninot — joined 2012/2013 (official and press differ)

history.zh: Ninot 家族在 Rully 的种植与制桶历史可追溯至十四世纪。Pierre-Marie 维持并重建家族葡萄园；Erell 2003 年返乡，Flavien 2012/2013 年加入，逐步以地块单酿突出 Rully 的红白两色潜力。
history.en: The Ninot family traces viticulture and coopering in Rully to the 14th century. Pierre-Marie rebuilt the inherited estate; Erell returned in 2003 and Flavien joined around 2012/13. Their wines focus on distinct Rully parcels in both colours.

land.zh: 约 13 ha（酒庄/行业资料），覆盖 Rully 与约 2 ha Mercurey，包含 Grésigny、Marissou 等一级园。
land.en: About 13 ha across Rully and Mercurey, with Rully Grésigny and Marissou Premier Crus; roughly 2 ha in Mercurey are cited in critic profile.

viticulture.zh: 2020 年取得 Agriculture Biologique 有机认证；注重土壤维护和人工地块操作。
viticulture.en: Certified organic in 2020; emphasis on soils and individual plot management.

vinification.zh: 采用地块为基础的独立酿造，并以桶熟呈现质地。具体去梗、整串比例、温度与新桶比例必须依据各技术单和年份记录。
vinification.en: Parcel-led cellar approach with oak élevage; stem inclusion, temperature and new-wood regimes require label/vintage-specific sheets.

ownership.zh: Ninot 家族经营；兄妹 Erell / Flavien 为目前核心人物。
ownership.en: Family estate run by Erell and Flavien Ninot.

record.name: Domaine Jaeger-Defaix
people: Hélène Jaeger-Defaix — took initial 1er Cru Montpalais in 2002
Henri Niepce — historical advocate for Rully AOC

history.zh: Hélène Jaeger-Defaix 于 2002 年接过来自姑婆 Henriette Niepce 的 Rully Montpalais 白一级园；2003 年继续接手 Préaux 红地块，2005 年开始整体管理约 4.5 ha 家族葡萄园。Niepce 家族自十六世纪种葡萄，Henri Niepce 参与推动 1930 年代 Rully 法定产区地位。
history.en: In 2002 Hélène Jaeger-Defaix received Montpalais from great-aunt Henriette Niepce; she took on Préaux in 2003 and managed the c.4.5-ha family estate from 2005. The Niepce family has centuries of local vineyard history.

land.zh: 早期经营约 4–4.5 ha；分销商近期资料列约 6.5 ha，其中约 4.5 ha 位于一级园，另生产村庄级 Rully。核心一级园为 Montpalais、Les Cloux、Rabourcé、Préaux 与 Clos du Chapitre。
land.en: Earlier holdings were around 4–4.5 ha; recent distributor data cites 6.5 ha, of which about 4.5 ha is Premier Cru. Main climats: Montpalais, Les Cloux, Rabourcé, Préaux and Clos du Chapitre, alongside village wines.

viticulture.zh: 分销商及有机葡萄酒渠道资料记载 2007 年以来采用有机方式耕种，采取翻耕、控芽、人工采收；是否具有当前有效的具体法定有机认证需与证书对应。
viticulture.en: Importer and specialist sources describe organic farming since 2007, ploughing, de-budding and hand harvest. Exact present certification wording still requires certificate verification.

vinification.zh: 白一级园多为桶中发酵及 12 个月桶熟后再不锈钢熟成；红一级园约 15 日发酵、每日 remontage、后桶熟和罐熟。新桶比例依 Préaux 与 Clos du Chapitre 不同。
vinification.en: Premier Cru whites usually barrel fermented and aged 12 months before stainless; reds around 15-day fermentation then barrel and steel. New-oak ratios differ by wine.

ownership.zh: Jaeger-Defaix / Niepce 家族独立庄园，官网关联 Bernard Defaix 家族酒庄，但应保留不同 Producer 身份。
ownership.en: Family estate connected to the Defaix family; do not merge producer identity with Domaine Bernard Defaix.

record.name: Domaine Michel Briday

history.zh: Michel Briday 于 1970 年代创立家族酒庄，Stéphane 和 Sandrine 延续经营。酒庄长期强调按地块采取不同成熟度和桶陈管理，不以重桶覆盖 Rully 的新鲜感。
history.en: Founded in the 1970s by Michel Briday and continued by Stéphane and Sandrine Briday, with an emphasis on site-dependent harvesting and restrained oak.

land.zh: 外部历史资料约 13.7–15 ha，面积需核对年份；拥有 Grésigny、La Pucelle、Les Cloux 白一级园及 Champs Cloux、Les Pierres 红一级园，另有未列为一级园的 Clos de Remenot Monopole。
land.en: Historic third-party area estimates vary roughly 13.7–15 ha. Rully white Premiers Crus include Grésigny, La Pucelle and Les Cloux; reds Champs Cloux and Les Pierres, plus village Clos de Remenot Monopole.

viticulture.zh: 人工采收，依地块控制成熟度；相关资料曾列 Terra Vitis 2014 认证，现行状态应另外核验证书。
viticulture.en: Manual harvesting, site-tailored ripeness; 2014 Terra Vitis claim appears in tourism history, but contemporary certification should be checked.

vinification.zh: 白葡萄酒直接压榨、天然酵母、300/400 L 桶或罐发酵，比例依酒款。红葡萄精选果实、可保留少量整串、原生酵母、3–8 天前浸、总发酵浸渍 20–25 天，部分 25% 新桶。
vinification.en: Whites are direct pressed and fermented with native yeast in 300/400 L barrels or vats by cuvée. Reds may use limited whole clusters, pre-fermentation maceration, indigenous yeast, 20–25-day vinification and oak according to individual label.

record.name: Domaine Belleville
people: Current operating leadership not established from consulted official estate pages

history.zh: 二十世纪初起源于 Rully。现经营 Rully、Mercurey、Monthélie 以及少量 Côte d’Or 葡萄园；2023 年扩展经营 Monthélie 地块。
history.en: Founded in Rully in the early twentieth century. The estate now works vineyards in Rully, Mercurey, Monthélie and small Côte d’Or plots, with Monthélie added in 2023.

land.zh: 官网：自有/长期经营 18 ha，2023 年起另管约 4.5 ha Monthélie，合计超过 22 ha；Rully 10.5 ha（Chardonnay 8.25、Pinot Noir 2.25）；五款白一级园和一款红一级园。
land.en: Official website: 18 ha owned/farmed plus 4.5 ha managed in Monthélie, just over 22 ha total; 10.5 ha at Rully (8.25 Chardonnay, 2.25 Pinot Noir). Five Premier Cru whites and one red.

viticulture.zh: 官网称其 18 ha 自 2021 年份获得有机认证，新增 Monthélie 4.5 ha 处于转换期。不能将认证自动扩大到全部土地。
viticulture.en: The 18-ha core is stated certified organic from vintage 2021; the additional Monthélie hectares entered conversion. Certification scope should not be extended automatically.

vinification.zh: 官网主张每个地块单独处理，不在酿造/熟成中混合；少量 SO₂、相对节制的新桶与较大桶型。各酒款官网列出自己的桶陈月数和新桶比例，缺具体年份。
vinification.en: Individual parcel vinification without blending in cellar; restrained sulphur/new oak, larger barrels. Oak regimes are documented as label baselines, not verified per vintage.

ownership.zh: 当前所有权/法人股权尚未从当前官网核实，不编造历史收购或经营人。
ownership.en: Current corporate ownership and managing directors not verified in consulted sources.

record.name: Domaine de la Folie
people: Elisabeth and Jérôme Noël-Bouton — preceding generation
Clémence and Baptiste Dubrulle — management since 2010

history.zh: 坐落 Chagny，家族长期拥有。酒庄历史人物包含摄影运动研究先驱 Étienne-Jules Marey、画家 Victor Bouton，以及 Noël-Bouton 家族。Clémence 与 Baptiste Dubrulle 自 2010 年经营，为第五代。
history.en: Located in Chagny, an estate with five family generations and historical connections to Étienne-Jules Marey, painter Victor Bouton and the Noël-Bouton family. Clémence and Baptiste Dubrulle have run the domaine since 2010.

land.zh: 官网称约 13 ha，代表地块为 Rully Premier Cru Clos Saint-Jacques（官方所述 monopole）、Clos du Chaigne 及村庄级 Clos la Folie、Clos de Bellecroix。
land.en: Official site describes c.13 ha including Premier Cru Clos Saint-Jacques and Clos du Chaigne, plus village-level Clos la Folie and Clos de Bellecroix.

viticulture.zh: 官网标注 culture raisonnée、人工小箱采收，白葡萄酒轻压榨、精细澄清；红葡萄成熟后完全去梗。
viticulture.en: Sustainable-oriented farming, hand picked in small crates; whites gently pressed and settled; reds fully destemmed according to official cuvée sheets.

vinification.zh: 不同酒款区分不锈钢与木桶：Clos la Folie 白酒不用木桶；一级园白酒使用约 20% 新桶；Clos de Bellecroix 红酒在罐熟，Cuvée Marey 约 20% 新桶。官方网站称“发酵过程不加 SO₂”，并不等于装瓶 SO₂ 为零。
vinification.en: Cuvées differ substantially: Clos la Folie white is tank matured; Premier Cru whites have stated 20% new barrels; Clos de Bellecroix red uses tank, while Cuvée Marey uses 20% new barrel. “No SO2 during fermentation” does NOT mean zero sulphur at bottling.

ownership.zh: Dubrulle/Noël-Bouton 家族承继；具体股权比例未知。
ownership.en: Family continuity Dubrulle/Noël-Bouton; exact legal shares not asserted.

record.name: Domaine Rois Mages

history.zh: Anne-Sophie 及其丈夫于 1980 年代初在勃艮第安家并取得 Rully 葡萄园；儿子 Félix 于 2009 年返庄，扩展酒庄的分地块表达。
history.en: Anne-Sophie and her husband acquired Rully vineyard interests in the early 1980s. Their son Félix joined in 2009, building a parcel-led range.

land.zh: 官方酒单列出 Rully 村庄级 Les Cailloux、Plante Moraine、Clos du Moulin à Vent、Chaponières 以及 Les Pierres 一级园，另有 Bouzeron 和 Beaune。官网首页“7”与“8”个 climats 描述口径不一致，暂不做单一数字断言。
land.en: Rully village sites Les Cailloux, Plante Moraine, Clos du Moulin à Vent and Chaponières, plus Premier Cru Les Pierres, and Bouzeron/Beaune. Website alternately describes seven and eight climats; scope unresolved.

viticulture.zh: 根据官网进行各地块分别种植管理；认证未证实。
viticulture.en: Parcel-specific farming according to estate; no certification invented.

vinification.zh: 官网叙述全部酒款约 12 个月桶熟，随后在不锈钢罐中经历第二个冬季的细酒泥熟成。该描述为通用基准，不代表每年毫无差异。
vinification.en: Estate says 12 months in barrel followed by a second winter on fine lees in stainless steel, treated as generic baseline rather than a vintage guarantee.

record.name: Domaine Jean-Baptiste Ponsot

history.zh: 1954 年由 Lucien Ponsot 创立，儿子 Bernard 逐步将混合农业转为专门葡萄园经营。Jean-Baptiste 2000 年、20 岁时接手；2005 年新建酒窖/接待空间，增植土地并深化地块研究。与 Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot、Morey-Saint-Denis 的 Domaine Ponsot 均为不同实体。
history.en: Founded in 1954 by Lucien Ponsot and expanded by his son Bernard. Jean-Baptiste took over in 2000 and built new cellar facilities in 2005. Separate from Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot and Domaine Ponsot in Morey-Saint-Denis.

land.zh: 官网约 8.8 ha：Rully Premier Cru 5.10 ha，Village 3.36 ha，Aligoté 0.21 ha、Chassagne-Montrachet 0.08 ha。官网该分项合计 8.75 ha，是四舍五入，不应自行改成 8.8 精确分项。Molesme 3.05 ha（Chardonnay 1.30、Pinot Noir 1.75）；Montpalais 1.71 ha；En Bas de Vauvry 3.03 ha 属 Village。
land.en: Website c.8.8 ha (subparts 5.10 Premier Cru, 3.36 Village, 0.21 Aligoté, 0.08 Chassagne = 8.75 ha due to rounding). Molesme 3.05 ha across both varieties; Montpalais 1.71 ha; En Bas de Vauvry 3.03 ha is **Village** despite the RVF article listing 1er Cru.

viticulture.zh: 2007 年起禁止除草剂/杀虫剂等，修剪与叶幕及草生管理按园变化；官网表述 culture raisonnée，不等于取得有机证书。
viticulture.en: Since 2007 the estate says it ceased herbicide/insecticide use, with plot-specific canopy, training and soil regimes; sustainable is not automatically certified organic.

vinification.zh: 红酒采前/采后两次分选、约 4–6 天冷浸、总浸渍约 21 天；白酒压榨后澄清 24 h，约 20°C 桶中发酵；各酒款约 12 个月桶熟、3 个月合桶，木桶比例从约 20% 至 40% 不等。官网通用简述“一成至三成”与个别酒款 40% 有差异，优先保留逐款数字。
vinification.en: Reds sorted twice, cold-soaked c.4–6 days and cuvaison c.21 days; whites settled for 24h and barrel-fermented around 20°C. Most wines are aged around 12 months in barrel plus c.3 months bulk rest; individual new-oak ratios 20–40% supersede estate-wide simplifications.

ownership.zh: Ponsot 家族，Jean-Baptiste 独立经营。

record.name: Domaine Saint-Jacques

history.zh: 家族在 1955 年创立/接手酒庄，由 Christophe-Amédée 开始。Christophe-Jean 于 1991 年进入经营；第三代 Christophe-Andréa 约 2021/22 年承接日常管理。
history.en: Family estate established in 1955 by Christophe-Amédée Grandmougin; Christophe-Jean followed in 1991 and Christophe-Andréa continued from around 2021/22.

land.zh: RVF 2027 指约 10 ha，以白葡萄为主；生产 Rully Village、Marissou 和 La Fosse 一级园，同时有 Bourgogne Aligoté。
land.en: RVF producer profile cites about 10 ha mainly in white wine, with Rully Village, Marissou and La Fosse Premiers Crus, plus Bourgogne Aligoté.

viticulture.zh: 人工采收；2018 年有媒体记载有机方向转换，但最新认证未在本批核实。
viticulture.en: Hand-picked, with historically reported organic-oriented conversion; recent certification not verified.

vinification.zh: 白酒与红酒均采用酒庄传统发酵熟成方法；各酒款当前木桶比例和 2024 年份技术单待取得。
vinification.en: Vintage-specific technical parameters unavailable for the current set; do not transplant 2018 cellar observations to 2024.

record.name: Maison Trimbach
record.name_zh: Maison Trimbach

history.zh: 家族酿酒历史始于 1626 年；Clos Sainte Hune 与 Cuvée Frédéric Emile 是不同的标志性 Riesling 酒款。
history.en: Family wine history from 1626; Clos Sainte Hune and Cuvée Frédéric Emile are two separate Riesling bottlings.

record.name: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht
record.name_zh: Domaine Zind-Humbrecht

history.zh: 阿尔萨斯重要地块型酒庄，Rangen Clos Saint Urbain 与 Brand、Clos Windsbuhl 并非同一 AOC 或地点。
history.en: Key Alsatian terroir estate; Rangen Clos Saint Urbain, Brand and Clos Windsbuhl are geographically distinct.

record.name: Clos Rougeard
record.name_zh: Clos Rougeard

history.zh: Le Bourg 与 Les Poyeux 为 Saumur-Champigny 的不同地块酒，Brézé 则是 Saumur Blanc；产权变化须以日期核对。
history.en: Le Bourg and Les Poyeux are Saumur-Champigny parcel wines, while Brézé is a separate Saumur white wine.

record.name: Domaine des Baumard
record.name_zh: Domaine des Baumard

history.en: Quarts de Chaume and Savennières Clos du Papillon are in distinct appellations; do not merge them.

record.name: Domaine Jean-Louis Chave
record.name_zh: Domaine Jean-Louis Chave

history.zh: Hermitage 地块和不同 cuvée 需单独关联；Cuvée Cathelin 并非每个年份都有出品。
history.en: Hermitage wines require vintage-specific cuvée availability; Cuvée Cathelin is not produced every vintage.

record.name: Domaine Tempier
record.name_zh: Domaine Tempier

history.zh: 家族自十九世纪起与 Bandol 相连；Lucien Peyraud 是战后 Bandol 与 Mourvèdre 发展中的关键人物。
history.en: The estate is rooted in the Peyraud family history; Lucien Peyraud played a central role in the 20th-century promotion of Bandol and Mourvèdre.

vinification.zh: La Migoua、La Tourtine、Cabassaou 作为独立风土地块酒；单一年份的品种组成和橡木桶比例仍待核验。
vinification.en: La Migoua, La Tourtine and Cabassaou are distinct site-specific bottlings, not interchangeable with the entry-level Bandol bottling.

record.name: Château d'Esclans
record.name_zh: Château d'Esclans

history.zh: Whispering Angel、Rock Angel、Les Clans、Garrus 是不同酒款层级；细分酒款技术规格必须逐款逐年份核验。
history.en: The cuvée hierarchy includes Whispering Angel, Rock Angel, Les Clans and Garrus, with no implied common barrel regime.

record.name: Domaines Ott
record.name_zh: Domaines Ott

history.zh: 酒庄体系按 Château de Selle、Clos Mireille 与 Château Romassan 三个庄园组织，不应把三个 estate 合并为一个地块。
history.en: The Ott group portfolio spans distinct estates: Château de Selle, Clos Mireille and Château Romassan.

record.name: Château Lafite Rothschild
record.name_zh: Château Lafite Rothschild

history.zh: 波尔多 Pauillac 一级庄。与 Duhart-Milon 的所有权关联应单独建立 group ownership 关系，不把两庄产品合并。
history.en: Pauillac First Growth. Connected ownership to Duhart-Milon must remain distinct from producer identity and cuvée inventory.

record.name: Domaine Renardat-Fâche
record.name_zh: Domaine Renardat-Fâche

history.zh: 酒庄家族在 Mérignat 种植葡萄逾八代；Léon 与 Cécile 战后参与推广 Cerdon méthode ancestrale。Élie 于 1996 年参与经营；2008 年转有机，酒庄声明 2012 年获得 Ecocert 认证。
history.en: Eight-plus generations in Mérignat. Léon and Cécile helped refine Cerdon méthode ancestrale after WWII. Élie joined in 1996; conversion to organic began 2008, with 2012 Ecocert certification reported by the producer.

vinification.zh: Cerdon 采用 méthode ancestrale；必须把中断发酵、冷却及残糖等技术按酒款和年份核对。
vinification.en: Cerdon méthode ancestrale involves controlled fermentation and chilling; blend, residual sugar and process require vintage-specific data.

record.name: Maison Lelièvre
record.name_zh: Maison Lelièvre

history.zh: Lorraine Lucey 家族酒庄，由 Vincent 负责生产、David 负责经营；酒庄官网记载约 20 公顷酿酒来源，Gamay、Pinot Noir、Auxerrois、Pinot Gris 采用有机种植。注意其他市场宣传有不同面积口径。
history.en: Family winery at Lucey, with Vincent responsible for wine production and David for management; official estate page reports wine made from nearly 20 ha with organic Gamay, Pinot Noir, Auxerrois and Pinot Gris. Other marketing sources give conflicting area figures.

vineyards.area_as_of: estate page approximate 2026 access; planted/owned/vinified area unclear

record.name: Domaine Sontag
record.name_zh: Domaine Sontag

history.zh: 家族在 Contz-les-Bains 经营；Marie-Antoinette 与 Gérard 于 1965 年代复兴葡萄种植，Claude Sontag 自 2007 年经营，Mélanie 于 2020 年加入。
history.en: Family winery in Contz-les-Bains: Marie-Antoinette and Gérard revived farming around 1965; Claude took over in 2007, joined by Mélanie in 2020.

record.name: Domaine les Béliers
record.name_zh: Domaine les Béliers

history.zh: Ancy-sur-Moselle 家族酒庄，葡萄园位于 Les Béliers，约 280 米海拔，主要朝东至东南。
history.en: Family wine estate at Ancy-sur-Moselle; vineyards around the Les Béliers lieu-dit at c.280 m, predominantly E–SE exposure.

vinification.zh: 酒庄资料提及手采、自然酵母／低添加硫、短熟 6 个月与较长熟成 10–18 个月系列；单款仍须另核实。
vinification.en: Estate describes hand picking, limited sulfur, short 6-month tank élevage and some 10–18 month longer élevage; specific cuvées require matching.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Bandol property with roots before the modern revival. Lucie 'Lulu' Tempier and Lucien Peyraud took over in 1940; the estate began replanting Mourvèdre, Cinsault and Grenache from 1943. Jean-Marie and François Peyraud developed parcel-specific red cuvées in the 1960s. Winery foudre cellar built in 1968.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: Historical Rounard–Tempier/Peyraud family estate. Estate history describes children Jean-Marie, François and their siblings' family governance after 2000, with Daniel Ravier responsible for daily management at time of that estate text. This is a source-era claim; exact current shareholders and manager as of 2026 need reconfirmation.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: Estate official site describes a c.60 ha terroir mosaic: La Bastide (c.7 ha, source for classical blends), La Tourtine (c.5.5 ha, sunny/south and windy Santonian sandstone/marl/clay), La Migoua (c.11 ha, complex overthrust Triassic clay-limestone in Beausset-Vieux), Cabassaou (c.1.5 ha, warm sheltered amphitheater), La Laidière (c.18 ha, east-facing, purchased 2016, contributes to freshness in white/rose). Do not infer all land is individually owned without cadastral source.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Existing six wine identity entries: Bandol Blanc, Rosé, Rouge (historically Classique/Lulu & Lucien red), single-site red La Tourtine, La Migoua, Cabassaou. Official site currently describes Cuvée Lulu & Lucien red (check historical labeling against classic Bandol Rouge before changing label identity). Separate single-site from entry cuvées, no blanket vintage blend formula.

sections.text: Maury, Roussillon in the Agly valley. Winery reports about 95 distinct parcels, 100 ha vineyard reference on current estate page, old-vine Grenache and Carignan in schist/calcareous schist landscapes. Historical 1999 source states 155 ha planted of 226 total then; values are different date/definition, never conflate. Organic certification 2017; biodynamic certification according to estate by 2020.

sections.title: Portfolio

Estate also produces dry Maury Sec/Côtes du Roussillon. Do not treat this 9-entity orphan group as exhaustive estate portfolio or all current products.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: Estate's own official account describes 21 hectares of vineyards on decomposed granitic sands near 150m altitude in Taravo valley, Casalabriva, with an ampelographic collection preserving diverse native varieties. Biodynamic viticulture; precise parcel-by-cuvée origin and official land-title verification pending.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Biodynamic production and native Corsican varietal conservation per official estate. The term '18 old/native varieties' on site is a conservation count, not a universal ingredient count for each cuvée.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: Portfolio approaches vary: Faustine whites/rosés mostly stainless; red structured maceration, Collection whites demi-muid & inox; Parcellaires may use foudre, demi-muid, tank. No blanket all-vintages rule.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: At least 10 distinct wine identities among 11 existing source records: Faustine Blanc, Rouge, Rosé (+ separate historical Faustine Vieilles Vignes Rosé), Parcellaires Alte Rosso Blanc, Monte Bianco Rouge, Valle di Nero Rosé, Collection Ministre Impérial Rouge, Diplomate d'Empire Blanc, Général de la Révolution Blanc. Existing 2 'Ministre Impérial' records use different origination labels, one Ajaccio AOC and another Vin de France; official current technical sheet says Vin de France — hold the Ajaccio record for source/label reconciliation; no automatic merge. Official additional Empire Sparkling, Dolce Rosso and Insolites Valle di Mare/Monte Mare not yet among 11, audit for expansion later.
